title: Claim Management
description: Browse and process exchange, return, refund and cancellation requests

linked.title: Follow-up refund requests
linked.empty: No refund request has been filed for this request.

detail.title: Claim Detail
detail.description: Review and process the progress and history of a claim request

progress.title: Progress
progress.collection_counts: Arrived {{collected}} · In transit {{in_transit}} · Waiting {{pending}} · Not returned {{unreturned}} / {{total}}

items.title: Requested Items
items.bulk_no_status_selected: Select the status to change to.
items.bulk_success: Item status changes have been processed.
items.no_common_transition: The selected items have no status they can all move to. Select items that share the same status.
items.cancel_not_transitionable: Cancellation requests have no per-item status to change. A cancellation is final as soon as it is filed.
items.quantity_confirm_description: The selected items will be moved to {{status}}. Reduce a quantity to process only part of it.
items.quantity_not_splittable: An exchange item whose redelivery item already exists cannot be split. It will be processed in full.
items.bulk_split_notice: Processed {{kept}} items; {{remaining}} left in their current state.
items.bulk_split_notice_one: Processed {{kept}} item; {{remaining}} left in their current state.
items.tracking_only_description: Saves the {{direction}} waybill on the selected items only. Status does not change.
items.quantity_split_hint: Lowering the quantity splits the item — e.g. applying to 1 of 3 shirts splits it into 1 and 2.
items.tracking_mixed_address: Items with different return addresses cannot share one waybill. Save them per return address.

completion.title: Completion
completion.description: Move {{count}} requested items to completed. Stock restoration and refund request options are chosen on the next screen.
completion.description_one: Move {{count}} requested item to completed. Stock restoration and refund request options are chosen on the next screen.
completion.unavailable_return: No items are being collected or have been collected yet, so this cannot be completed. You can complete it once items are being collected.
completion.unavailable_exchange: No replacement items are being shipped or have been delivered yet, so this cannot be completed. You can complete it once replacement items are being shipped.
completion.stock_unrestored: {{count}} completed items with stock not restored
completion.stock_unrestored_one: {{count}} completed item with stock not restored

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.redelivery_not_applicable: This claim type has no redelivery step.
shipping.tracking_incomplete: Enter both the carrier and the tracking number.
shipping.tracking_error: Failed to save the tracking information.
shipping.edit_hint: To record or fix a waybill, select items in the claim items section and use [Save waybill only].

reason.title: Reason

images_clear_confirm.title: Delete all attachments
images_clear_confirm.message: All {{count}} attachments on this request will be deleted.
images_clear_confirm.message_one: The {{count}} attachment on this request will be deleted.
images_clear_confirm.warning: Photos the customer uploaded as evidence are deleted too, and this cannot be undone.

reason.confirm_remove_image_message: The image and its file are deleted together. This cannot be undone.

comparison.title: Order amounts at filing (before / after)
comparison.empty: No comparison was recorded when this request was filed

cancel_info.title: Cancellation
cancel_info.reactivated_hint: An operator restored the items removed by this cancellation to an active status. The cancellation and refund records are kept.

memo.title: Admin Memo
memo.placeholder: Internal processing notes (not shown to the customer)
memo.saved: The admin memo has been saved.
memo.error: Failed to save the admin memo.
memo.not_supported: Refund requests do not store an admin memo.
memo.not_supported_cancel: Cancellation requests do not store an admin memo.

payment.no_payment: This order has no payment record.

settlement.title: Settlement for this claim
settlement.nothing_to_save: There is no amount to save.
settlement.void_failed: The approval could not be reversed at the payment provider. Cancel this payment in the provider's admin console.
settlement.paid_transition_failed: The payment is complete, but the request could not move to the next step. Change its status manually.
settlement.blocked_already_filed: A refund request has already been filed (see the list above).
settlement.blocked_not_applicable: There is nothing to file a refund request for.
settlement.fee_basis_no_policy: No shipping policy could be resolved, so this was treated as 0. Please check the shipping policy settings.
settlement.fee_basis_api_fallback: This shop uses an external rate API, so the base shipping fee was used.
settlement.fee_basis_live_policy: No order-time snapshot exists, so the current rate table was used - changing the rate table changes this amount.
settlement.exchange_difference_refund: Exchange difference refund (to the original method)
settlement.file_refund_success: The refund request has been filed.
settlement.file_refund_error: Failed to file the refund request.

refund_execute.reserved: Expected refunds from other in-progress claims (info)
refund_execute.unavailable: The cancellable amount could not be calculated.
refund_execute.points_not_deducted: No mileage is returned because the mileage used on this order was never deducted.
refund_execute.exceeds: The amount exceeds the cancellable limit.
refund_execute.manual_transfer_notice: No PG integration was found for this payment method, so the refund fell back to a bank transfer. Send the money manually, then press Refund to mark it complete. Reinstalling the PG plugin restores automatic refunds.
refund_execute.points_cash_credit_notice: With "Refund as mileage", the cash refund amount is also credited to the member's mileage (no expiry). No card cancellation or bank transfer takes place, and the payment stays as paid.
refund_execute.pg_settled_pending_ledger_notice: The PG refund has already gone through, but recording it failed. Press [Refund] to record it without calling the PG again.
refund_execute.conflict: It has already been executed or is in progress. Refresh and check again.

modal.title: Confirm refund execution
modal.description: The refund for claim {{number}} will be executed.
modal.warning: A refund cannot be undone. Please check the amounts and the refund method.
modal.points_cash_credit: The cash refund amount will be credited as mileage.

refund_execute.refund_bank_input_hint: This refund is completed by a manual bank transfer. The claim has no account on file, so you can enter it here — the value is saved to the claim as well.
refund_execute.force_without_bank: Record as completed without an account
refund_execute.force_without_bank_hint: No transfer happens; only the claim is closed as refunded. Use this only when the money was already sent another way or will not be paid — it cannot be undone.
refund_execute.refund_bank_required: Enter the account to refund to, or consent to recording it as completed without an account.

transition.title: Change request status
transition.no_status_selected: Select a status to change to.
transition.success: The request status has been changed.
transition.error: Failed to change the request status.

exchange_mode.label: Exchange mode
exchange_mode.confirm_advance: The new item ships first and the original must come back within {{days}} days of shipping. Switch to advance exchange?
exchange_mode.confirm_advance_one: The new item ships first and the original must come back within {{days}} day of shipping. Switch to advance exchange?
exchange_mode.confirm_standard: Return to the standard flow: receive the original first, then ship the new item.
exchange_mode.error: Could not change the exchange mode.
exchange_mode.overdue_banner: The return deadline ({{date}}) passed {{days}} days ago. Ask the customer to send it back or consider completing as not returned.
exchange_mode.overdue_banner_one: The return deadline ({{date}}) passed {{days}} day ago. Ask the customer to send it back or consider completing as not returned.

pending_refund.banner: A refund request has not been filed yet — {{amount}}

request_edit.title: Edit request
request_edit.description: Edit the reason and details. Seller-fault reasons are available too.
request_edit.fee_hint: If the fault changes, the shipping fee is recalculated and pending or paid charges are adjusted to match.

detail.withdrawn_by_admin: Withdrawn by {{name}} at the customer's request

withdraw_on_behalf.title: Withdraw at customer request
withdraw_on_behalf.description: Use when the customer asked to cancel the request. The customer is told it was withdrawn by the seller at their request. This is not a rejection.
withdraw_on_behalf.success: The request was withdrawn as the customer asked.

bulk.no_status_selected: Select the status to change to.
bulk.cancel_not_transitionable: Cancellations are not subject to bulk status changes.
bulk.confirm_message: Change the status of {{count}} selected claims.
bulk.confirm_message_one: Change the status of {{count}} selected claim.
bulk.success: The bulk status change has been processed.
bulk.skipped_notice: {{count}} claims were not processed. First reason: {{reason}}

complete.description: Move {{count}} selected claims to completed. Review how each one is handled.
complete.description_one: Move {{count}} selected claim to completed. Review how it is handled.
complete.discard_note: Unchecked claims are completed without restoring stock (treated as discarded).
complete.refund_later_desc: File later via [File refund request] or the order detail refund modal.
complete.blocked_exists: A refund request has already been filed.
complete.skipped_notice: {{count}} claims could not be found and are excluded.
complete.skipped_notice_one: {{count}} claim could not be found and is excluded.
complete.no_target: There is no claim that can be completed.
complete.preview_error: Could not load the completion summary.
complete.refund_later_desc_cancellation: Without a refund request no money leaves this completion, so no cancellation record is created either. You can file one later from the settlement card on the request detail.
complete.unreturned_desc: The new item was sent but the original never came back. Checked items complete as "not returned" without restoring stock.
complete.unreturned_no_charge_notice: Completing as not returned does not charge the customer for the item. Charge them separately if needed.
complete.unreturned_reason_required: Enter a reason for each item completed as not returned.
